text:
Maria: Heads-up — PR #12816 is blocked on merge, CI failing intermittently on e2e:CheckoutFlow. Getting a couple of different flakes across runs, not consistent. :thinking:
Devin: @Maria can you paste the failing log? sounds like a timeout from previous runs. :eyes:
Maria: Pasting the most recent failure snippet:
```
=== FAIL: TestCheckoutFlow (0.12s)
panic: timeout waiting for payment gateway mock (POST /mock/pay)
  checkout_test.go:142: expected response in 50ms, got 250ms
--- FAIL: TestCheckoutFlow (0.12s)
FAIL
```
Paul: That panic smells like a mock race or infra slow. We had a similar transient in staging last week when the mock container was OOMing. Any OOM logs?
Maria: No clear OOM in that run. Buildkite link: https://buildkite.company/teams/redwood/builds/98765 — failing shard is e2e-2.
Devin: I'll eyeball the BK agent logs. Quick idea: try a targeted rerun for shard e2e-2 first. If it passes, we avoid snapshot churn. I can do 1 rerun.
Sophie: +1 on targeted rerun. If it fails twice, mark as flaky and open a follow-up to either add a small retry in the test or increase the mock timeout. We don't want snapshots changed for nondeterministic infra flakes.
Maria: Who has permission to rerun this PR? It's blocked in the merge queue. @Devin you said you can — please go ahead if you're free. :pray:
Devin: Doing a single targeted rerun now: `./scripts/ci_rerun.sh pr 12816 --shard e2e-2 --targeted`
ci-bot: Rerun queued by Devin for PR 12816 (shard e2e-2). Build 98766 started.
Paul: If rerun fails again, grep the agent stderr for `container killed` or `OOM killed` and also check our mock pod restart count: `kubectl get pods -n test -o wide | grep mock-gateway`
Sophie: Also check whether this test uses a shared resource that could be contended in parallel CI runs. If so, we should either parallelize differently or rename to serial shard.
Maria: Noted. If rerun passes, I'll merge and keep an eye for recurrence. If it fails again, we'll open a bug and schedule a bisect.
ci-bot: Build 98766 passed on shard e2e-2. Waiting on remaining shards.
Devin: Nice. Remaining shards are green so merge should proceed. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Queue alert — CI executor pool 3 usage spiking to 95% in us-west. If you see additional flask/timeout flakes, ping infra.
Maria: Thanks all — merging now. Filing a follow-up ticket to add a tiny retry to the payment mock (will assign after merge).
